title: Promotion Candidate
description: The UNTRUSTED, worker-staged input to the /promote-to-vault gate (sits in runs/<run>/inbox/). It carries REFERENCES to the real audit artifacts and a proposed vault target — never a self-claimed status (the gate re-derives status from the referenced audits, never from this object). This schema is the trust boundary: additionalProperties:false blocks smuggled fields (e.g. a forged can_cite_thesis or a worker-set human_freeze), and the patterned slug / vault_type / vault_folder are single lowercase-kebab path segments — they cannot carry '/', '\' or '..', so a candidate can never redirect the gate's write outside 02-wiki/<type>/ (the path-traversal class).

slug.description: Proposed lowercase-kebab slug — a single safe path segment, never renamed once promoted. Bounded length so an overlong segment can't reach (and crash) the filesystem call.

vault_type.description: Target knowledge-note type (e.g. 'result'). A single safe, bounded-length path segment.

vault_folder.description: Optional explicit 02-wiki subfolder. A single safe, bounded-length path segment (defaults to vault_type+'s'). Cannot escape 02-wiki/.

project.description: The registered research project this knowledge belongs to (lowercase-kebab slug from the vault's 05-registry/project-registry.md). When the vault has a project registry, the gate REJECTS a candidate whose project is not registered — promoted pages never carry an unknown project.

source_result_status.description: The source artifact's claimed status. ADVISORY ONLY — the gate re-derives the real status from the referenced audits and ignores a 'frozen' self-claim here.
